Compare normalised library sizes across methods

Source: R/library_size_runner.R
plot_library_size_comparison.Rd

Calculate and visualise total normalised expression across spatial locations for different normalisation methods.

Usage

plot_library_size_comparison(
  norm,
  methods = NULL,
  assay_name = "logcounts",
  point_size = 0.5,
  theme_name = "classic"
)

Arguments

norm

Named list of normalised SpatialExperiment objects.

methods

Character vector of methods to compare. If NULL, all methods except sctransform and Giotto are used.

assay_name

Name of the log-normalised assay. Default is "logcounts".

point_size

Point size for spatial maps.

theme_name

Plot theme.

Value

A list containing comparison data, boxplot, spatial plot, and combined plot.

Details

Log-normalised expression is back-transformed using expm1(), summed across genes, and transformed again using log1p().

Produces a boxplot and spatial maps.

By default, sctransform and Giotto are excluded because their transformed expression values may not represent log1p-transformed non-negative expression.

Examples

data(norm_example)

p_ls <- plot_library_size_comparison(
  norm_example,
  methods = NULL,
  assay_name = "logcounts",
  point_size = 0.5,
  theme_name = "classic"
)

p_ls$plot
